parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.1059). The aggressive lr 0.12/warmup 0.15 failed. Reverting to my best (1.093478). Next, I will try a more moderate increase: MATRIX_LR=0.11 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.10 to find a better balance between convergence and stability.
parsed.description: Conservative increase of MATRIX_LR to 0.11 and WARMUP_RATIO to 0.10 to stabilize higher learning rate.
